hook_text: The bike sat broken for a year

song.title: Squeaky Wheel
song.style: English, twangy surf rock with reverb guitar, driving drums, handclaps and a bouncy bass, warm friendly male lead vocal, sunny and fast, 128 BPM
song.lyrics:
[Verse]
Old red bike behind the door
Flat and rusty, one year more
I'd fix it up, I always said
Then I'd scroll my day instead

[Chorus]
Squeaky wheel, come on, let's ride
Oil the chain and pump the tyre
Squeaky wheel, the hill is steep
My phone is on the fridge asleep

[Verse]
Spanner, grease and a cup of tea
Bell goes ding, the brakes are free
Wobbled once and hit a hedge
Then I flew past the river's edge

[Chorus]
Squeaky wheel, come on, let's ride
Wind and sun and countryside
Squeaky wheel, the hill was steep
Top of the world and my phone's asleep

shots.prompt: A rusty old red bicycle with flat tyres and cobwebs leans behind a door in a dim hallway. The camera crash zooms in on it. Dim warm hallway light.
A little spider dangles from the handlebar of a dusty red bicycle and waves a leg. Extreme close-up, the camera pushes in. Dim warm light.
{moss} walks down a hallway past a rusty red bicycle, staring at a softly glowing phone and not looking at the bike. The camera tracks with him. Dim warm hallway light.
A flat bicycle tyre sags sadly on a wooden floor. Close-up, the camera tilts down. Dim warm light.

Close-up: {moss} sings to the camera, his mouth opening wide under his bushy mustache, sheepish, pointing a thumb over his shoulder at a rusty red bicycle behind him in a hallway. The camera pushes in. Warm hallway light.
The pages of a blank wall calendar flip by in a blur while the seasons change in the window beside it. The camera pushes in. Soft daylight.
{moss} lies on a green sofa with his boots up, lit by a softly glowing phone, while a rusty red bicycle sits in the shadows behind him. The camera dolly zooms. Dim grey light, warm lamp.
{moss} glances from his phone to a rusty red bicycle and back, then frowns thoughtfully. Close-up, the camera whip-pans between them. Warm lamp light.
{moss} wheels a rusty red bicycle out of his front door into bright sunshine. The camera pulls back fast through the doorway. Bright morning sun.
A rusty bicycle wheel turns slowly with a wobble. Extreme close-up, the camera orbits the hub. Bright morning sun.
{moss} drips oil from a little green oil can onto the chain of a red bicycle, tongue out in concentration. The camera pushes in on his hands. Bright morning sun.
{moss} pumps a bicycle pump up and down as fast as he can, his beanie's pom-pom bouncing, the tyre of a red bicycle swelling. The camera crash zooms in. Bright morning sun.

Close-up: {moss} sings to the camera, his mouth opening wide under his bushy mustache, determined, gripping the handlebars of a red bicycle, a steep green hill behind him. The camera pushes in fast. Bright morning sun.
A steep green hill with a winding road rises above a little town, a single tree at the very top. The camera cranes up the hill. Bright morning sun.

A black smartphone stands upright, face to the door, in a quilted moss-green brick stuck to a cream fridge door, a round sun-yellow badge with a closed eye on its front, a small shopping list held by a yellow magnet beside it. Soft leaf shadows sway slowly across the fridge door. Warm morning light. The camera pushes in slowly.
{moss} tiptoes out of a sunny kitchen with a finger to his lips, glancing back over his shoulder. The camera tracks with him. Warm morning light.
{moss} sits on a doorstep beside an upside-down red bicycle, a spanner in one hand and a steaming mug of tea in the other, grease on his cheek. The camera orbits around him. Bright morning sun.
A spanner tightens a shiny bolt on a bicycle wheel. Extreme close-up, the camera spins with the spanner. Bright morning sun.
A clay thumb flicks a shiny silver bicycle bell and it rings and sparkles. Extreme close-up, the camera crash zooms in. Bright morning sun.
{moss} squeezes both brake levers of a gleaming red bicycle and nods, impressed. Close-up, the camera pushes in. Bright morning sun.
{moss} wobbles down a country lane on a red bicycle, zigzagging wildly, and plunges head first into a big green hedge. The camera tracks with him, then crash zooms. Bright morning sun.
shots.frame: He rides a red bicycle along a country lane beside a big green hedge, wobbling, eyes wide, seen from the front. Full body. Bright morning sun.

shots.prompt: {moss} pops his head up out of a green hedge with leaves stuck in his mustache and gives a thumbs up. The camera crash zooms in. Bright morning sun.
shots.frame: A close-up of him with his head and shoulders poking up out of the top of a big green hedge, leaves stuck in his mustache. Bright morning sun.

shots.prompt: {moss} speeds along a path beside a sparkling river on a red bicycle, leaning into the wind. The camera tracks fast beside him. Bright midday sun.
Three ducks on a sparkling river turn their heads together as something red whooshes past. The camera whip-pans. Bright midday sun.

Close-up: {moss} sings to the camera, his mouth opening wide under his bushy mustache, thrilled, riding a red bicycle with the wind blowing his beanie's pom-pom back, green fields rushing by. The camera tracks backward in front of him. Bright midday sun.
{moss} rides a red bicycle with both feet off the pedals and his legs stuck straight out, whooping. The camera orbits fast around him. Bright midday sun.
FPV drone shot swooping low over rolling green fields, hedgerows and a winding country road with one small red bicycle on it. Bright midday sun.
A scarecrow in a straw hat and a patched blue jacket stands in a wheat field, its sleeve flapping like a wave as the wind rushes past. The camera whip-pans past it. Bright midday sun.
{moss} stands on the pedals of a red bicycle, grinding up a steep green hill, puffing, cheeks red. The camera tracks backward up the hill in front of him. Golden afternoon light.
{moss_back} pedals a red bicycle up the last stretch of a hill toward a single tree at the top, against a huge golden sky. The camera cranes up behind him. Golden afternoon light.
{moss} stands at the top of a hill holding a red bicycle above his head in triumph, a tiny town and a river far below. The camera orbits around him. Golden afternoon light.
{moss} lies in the grass under a tree at the top of a hill, a red bicycle on its side beside him, watching the clouds and taking a deep breath. The camera cranes slowly up. Golden evening light.

caption: the red bike waited a year behind the door. then moss put his phone in the Hibernator and found a spanner. only one hedge was harmed
